claims.claim: Historical REPAIR recovery now acquires one immutable TASK-scoped ls-remote --refs snapshot containing failure artifacts, successful artifacts, and failed candidate refs, then reconstructs the ordered correction lineage and remote RUN namespace by identity without ref-order inference.
Terminal RESULT/FAILURE conflicts and duplicate continuations are derived from the same snapshot, with deterministic regressions covering single-snapshot rejection.

Snapshot transport failures fail closed with bounded acquisition-stage, exit-status, and sanitized category provenance; successful-but-incomplete snapshots remain lineage failures; malformed, duplicate, wrong-prefix, wrong-TASK, and invalid-object results are rejected without retry.

Exact commit-SHA content retrieval and established TASK-058 lineage bindings remain intact, while ordinary transport helpers and downstream surfaces are unchanged and no retry, fallback, reroute, executor invocation, or product mutation was introduced.
